001package org.clafer.compiler;
002
003import org.chocosolver.solver.Model;
004import org.chocosolver.solver.Solver;
005import org.clafer.choco.ResetKeepsLimits;
006import org.clafer.common.Check;
007import org.clafer.instance.InstanceModel;
008
009/**
010 *
011 * @author jimmy
012 */
013public class ClaferSolver implements ClaferSearch {
014
015    private final Solver solver;
016    private final ClaferSolutionMap solutionMap;
017    private final boolean restartAfterEachSolution;
018    private int count = 0;
019    private boolean more = true;
020
021    ClaferSolver() {
022        Model model = new Model();
023        model.falseConstraint().post();
024        this.solver = model.getSolver();
025        this.solutionMap = null;
026        this.restartAfterEachSolution = false;
027    }
028
029    ClaferSolver(Solver solver, ClaferSolutionMap solutionMap) {
030        this(solver, solutionMap, false);
031    }
032
033    ClaferSolver(Solver solver, ClaferSolutionMap solutionMap, boolean restartAfterEachSolution) {
034        this.solver = Check.notNull(solver);
035        this.solutionMap = Check.notNull(solutionMap);
036        this.restartAfterEachSolution = restartAfterEachSolution;
037    }
038
039    public ClaferSolutionMap getSolutionMap() {
040        return solutionMap;
041    }
042
043    @Override
044    public boolean find() throws ReachedLimitException {
045        if (!more) {
046            return false;
047        }
048        if (restartAfterEachSolution) {
049            ResetKeepsLimits.reset(solver);
050            more &= solver.solve();
051        } else {
052            more &= solver.solve();
053        }
054        if (solver.isStopCriterionMet()) {
055            more = false;
056            throw new ReachedLimitException();
057        }
058        if (more) {
059            count++;
060        }
061        return more;
062    }
063
064    @Override
065    public InstanceModel instance() {
066        if (count == 0 || !more) {
067            throw new IllegalStateException("No instances. Did you forget to call find?");
068        }
069        return solutionMap.getInstance();
070    }
071
072    @Override
073    public int instanceCount() {
074        return count;
075    }
076
077    @Override
078    public Solver getInternalSolver() {
079        return solver;
080    }
081
082    @Override
083    public String toString() {
084        return solver.toString();
085    }
086}
